mapper.insert: INSERT INTO VOTE ( VOTE_ID, MEM_ID, STUDY_ID, VOTE_TITLE, VOTE_CONTENT, VOTE_SUBJECT, VOTE_START, VOTE_END )VALUES( 'V' || VOTE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, (SELECT MEM_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE MEM_LOGIN_ID = #{memLoginId}), #{studyId}, #{voteTitle}, #{voteContent}, #{voteSubject}, SYSDATE, TO_DATE(TRIM(#{voteEnd}), 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI') )
mapper.select: SELECT A.VOTE_ID, CASE C.STUDY_ROLL WHEN 'L' THEN '팀장' WHEN 'M' THEN '팀원' ELSE '미확인' -- 'L' 또는 'M'이 아닐 경우 기본값 처리 END AS STUDY_ROLL, B.MEM_NICK, A.VOTE_TITLE, A.VOTE_CONTENT, A.VOTE_SUBJECT, A.VOTE_START, A.VOTE_END, A.VOTE_OK FROM VOTE A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON (A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID) INNER JOIN STUDYMEMBER C ON (A.MEM_ID = C.MEM_ID AND A.STUDY_ID = C.STUDY_ID) WHERE A.VOTE_END < SYSDATE AND A.STUDY_ID = #{studyId}

SELECT T.VOTE_ID, T.STUDY_ROLL, T.MEM_NICK, T.VOTE_TITLE, T.VOTE_CONTENT, T.VOTE_SUBJECT, T.VOTE_START, T.VOTE_END, T.VOTE_OK FROM ( SELECT A.VOTE_ID, CASE C.STUDY_ROLL WHEN 'L' THEN '팀장' WHEN 'M' THEN '팀원' ELSE '미확인' END AS STUDY_ROLL, B.MEM_NICK, A.VOTE_TITLE, A.VOTE_CONTENT, A.VOTE_SUBJECT, A.VOTE_START, A.VOTE_END, A.VOTE_OK, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.STUDY_ID, TO_CHAR(A.VOTE_START, 'YYYYIW') ORDER BY A.VOTE_OK DESC, A.VOTE_ID ) AS RN FROM VOTE A INNER JOIN MEMBER B ON (A.MEM_ID = B.MEM_ID) INNER JOIN STUDYMEMBER C ON (A.MEM_ID = C.MEM_ID AND A.STUDY_ID = C.STUDY_ID) WHERE A.VOTE_END < SYSDATE AND A.STUDY_ID = #{studyId} ) T WHERE T.rn = 1 ORDER BY T.VOTE_START DESC
